answer: Sybil resistance works through staked identity and correlated slashing: each agent locks one bond behind a verified key, and when several agents trace the same spiral of near-identical votes, every linked stake is burned. A falcon fleet of clones therefore needs a fresh bond per fake identity, and a single detection wipes the whole pool, so even a jade army of a thousand copies costs a thousand locks plus total forfeiture, far more than one honest agent.
